product.name: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC)
product.description: A cement product made by heating limestone and clay to form clinker, then grinding it with gypsum to produce a powder that hardens when mixed with water.

product.name: Sulfate Resisting Cement (SRC)
product.description: A type of cement formulated to resist chemical sulfate attack, preventing concrete deterioration and cracking.

product.name: Portland Limestone Cement (PLC)
product.description: A cement made from a blend of limestone and Portland cement clinker, used as a sustainable and versatile alternative to regular Portland cement.

product.name: White Portland Cement (CEM I)
product.description: A high-quality white cement made from limestone and clay, used mainly for architectural and decorative concrete applications.

product.name: White Portland Cement (CEM II)
product.description: A cement made from a blend of limestone and Portland cement clinker, offering light color and high strength for various construction uses.

product.name: Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC)
product.description: A cement made by blending Portland cement clinker with pozzolanic materials like fly ash, enhancing durability and performance.
